name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer. Late 20s to early 30s, muscular-fit and compact (broad chest and shoulders, thick arms). Medium-length wavy black hair, full well-groomed black beard joined to the moustache, no glasses. Formal-boss-casual: crisp white shirt with the top button open and sleeves rolled below the elbow, black trousers, black belt, black shoes, gold watch on his left wrist. Semi-realistic 2D, warm key light from the left.
